acceptanceCriteria: Root cause identified: product race between ceiling expiry and LOST classification, or test timing.
The repeat --detach after the ceiling relaunches deterministically, or the test synchronises on the recorded state.
-count=50 of the test under heavy.sh load passes, retained.
body: Suspected race, seen once. PR #1059 CI run 39083146468 job 117544304684 (go-product-shard 5, 2026-10-18 00:50Z) failed at internal/tasks/cli/lease_detach_progress_test.go:73: the repeat `claim --detach` with request id claim-ceiling after the ceiling returned REFUSED SUPERVISOR_LOST (state LOST, childPid 14801, 'the detached claim ended without keeping a result'), where ATR-V0-066 / PSR-V0-111 (V1-1617, PR #1069) expect a relaunch. The same test passed on main CI at b74827c7f. Expected: a repeat --detach after the ceiling relaunches deterministically, or the test waits for the LOST/kept transition it depends on.
title: TestPSRV0111_CeilingRelaunchesOnSameRequestID flakes: repeated --detach after the ceiling returns SUPERVISOR_LOST instead of relaunching
